family.label: Aggregation
family.description: Transformations that combine multiple referents or structural components into a unified whole.

family.label: Association
family.description: Transformations that establish, alter, or represent relations among referents without implying containment.

family.label: Attestation
family.description: Transformations that record evidence, verification, or claims about a referent.

family.label: Branching
family.description: Transformations that produce divergent continuations from a referent.

family.label: Containment
family.description: Transformations that place a referent within a containing structure or organizational enclosure.

family.label: Contextual
family.description: Transformations that bind, unbind, or otherwise alter contextual placement or applicability.

family.label: Decomposition
family.description: Transformations that divide a referent into constituent components, each of which may itself be a referent.

family.label: Migration
family.description: Transformations that move a referent across a relation, bearer, context, or structural position, leaving its other relations in place.

family.label: Normative
family.description: Transformations that apply, alter, or record normative authority, permission, or standing.

family.label: Projection
family.description: Transformations that derive a partial view, selected representation, or projection of a referent.

family.label: Replication
family.description: Transformations that produce a duplicate, replica, copy, or copied representation of a referent.

family.label: Reorganization
family.description: Transformations that alter the arrangement or ordering of a referent's components without changing which components it has.

family.label: Scaling
family.description: Transformations that increase or decrease structural scale, detail, complexity, or elaboration.

family.label: Versioning
family.description: Transformations that establish or restore a referent's place in a temporally ordered version chain.
